en.authorizationHelp: You can reopen the authorization page or cancel and start again. Cancelling does not sign out an existing account.
en.automaticDetectionHelp: Checks common local proxy ports and environment variables without changing the saved connection.
en.autoReviewDetails: What is sent and how failures are handled
en.autoReviewDisclosure: Review requests send recent conversation text, relevant tool calls and results, tool arguments, the working directory, and the planned action to chatgpt.com. Hidden reasoning and stored credentials are not sent.
en.autoReviewFailureDisclosure: If the reviewer cannot complete, DSH keeps human approval. An explicit denial blocks the action.
en.callbackAccepted: Callback accepted. Waiting for authorization to finish…
en.callbackFailed: The callback could not be submitted. Try again or continue authorization.
en.callbackInvalid: The callback URL or authorization state is invalid. Copy the full URL from the current authorization and try again.
en.callbackNoPending: No authorization is pending. Continue authorization or start sign-in again.
en.callbackUnconfirmed: The submission timed out and may have been accepted. Continuing to check authorization status…
en.canceledDetail: Local waiting stopped. The request may still be processing.
en.capabilitiesIntro: Choose which extra Codex capabilities this dsh profile may register.
en.choosePreviewEdit: Use this conversation preview (the original is unavailable)
en.compatibilityPluginCurrentOnly: Codex Connect: Current {current} · Latest version unavailable
en.compatibilityPluginUpdateBody: Your installed plugin is not verified with this DSH version, but the latest plugin is. Update the plugin before DSH.
en.contextAboveDefault: Above the catalog default: larger requests may consume more quota or be rejected by your account or route. This plugin has not capacity-tested this range.
en.contextInvalid: Enter a whole-number budget within the model’s configuration range, or choose Restore default.
en.contextLimitFallback: No higher configuration limit confirmed; capped at the installed catalog default.
en.contextWarning: Context overrides change client budgeting, not server capacity. An excessive value can cause requests to fail. Hiding a model keeps its budget. Changes apply after Save.
en.currentConnectionFailed: The saved proxy could not reach the Codex endpoint.
en.directConnectionDescription: Codex Connect does not use a dedicated proxy.
en.editRequest: Continue from the previous image. Ask me what I want to change before generating a new image.
en.enableAutoReviewHelp: Send eligible approval requests from OpenAI-Codex sessions to a separate Codex reviewer. This changes who reviews; it does not expand DSH file, network, or tool permissions.
en.enableImageGenerationHelp: Generate or edit conversation images with GPT Image. When enabled, Codex requests include stable handles for conversation images so the model can select them; editing sends only the selected target and reference images to the image service.
en.enableImageToolHelp: Allows approved local reads and public-network image fetches for vision-capable models.
en.enableNativeCompactionHelp: Automatically use Codex native compaction when a long conversation needs context management. It aims to retain key requirements and task progress so long tasks can continue with less repeated background.
en.enableNewSessionFastModeHelp: Off by default. New top-level conversations using Codex request priority service; existing conversations and their manual choices stay unchanged. Priority may use quota faster.
en.enableNewSubagentFastMode: Fast Mode for new subagent conversations
en.enableNewSubagentFastModeHelp: A separate opt-in default for new subagent conversations using Codex. Off by default; it does not inherit the top-level setting.
en.enableReserveFallbackHelp: Use Luna Reserve only when the server explicitly authorizes it after ordinary usage is exhausted. Restore this conversation’s previous model when ordinary usage recovers. Adds quota checks; does not change global defaults or grant extra quota.
en.enableSearchHelp: Makes OpenAI Codex available and selects it for profile-wide web search while enabled.
en.fastModeDisabledTitle: Current: Standard speed. Click to enable 1.5× speed.
en.fastModeEnabledTitle: Current: 1.5× speed, with faster quota consumption. Click to switch to Standard speed.
en.fastModeLoadingTitle: Fast Mode state is loading for this conversation.
en.fastModeUnavailableTitle: Fast Mode is unavailable for this conversation.
en.generatingDetail: Image generation is in progress. Stopping cancels the current turn.
en.imageInputRecovery: Correct the selection or instructions in the conversation before retrying. Specify whether to edit the uploaded copy or the stored original; repeating these inputs will not resolve this error.
en.imageModelHintHelp: Optional unverified route hint; it may be ignored or rejected and does not guarantee the returned model.
en.imageRequestUncertain: The service may still be processing this request. Repeating it can consume additional quota.
en.imageStorageRecovery: Check local storage and available space before trying again. The service may already have processed this request.
en.imageUnknownFailure: The image request failed. Private service details are hidden; check the selected images and account before trying again.
en.intro: Use your ChatGPT subscription in dsh, with optional GPT Image generation and no API key.

en.invalidSearchTokens: Maximum search output tokens must be a positive whole number.
en.loadFailed: Image could not be loaded. Retry
en.manualCallbackHelp: Using a browser on another device? After ChatGPT authorization, a localhost connection error is expected because DSH runs elsewhere. Copy the full URL from that browser’s address bar and paste it here, including the entire query string. If you returned to this page, use Continue authorization (or Reopen authorization) to rejoin the pending sign-in.
en.manualCallbackPrivacy: This URL contains temporary sign-in secrets. Submit it only here; do not share it in chat, logs, or screenshots. The input is cleared after submission and is not saved.
en.manualCallbackToggle: Finish authorization with a callback URL
en.manualProxyHelp: Enter an HTTP(S) proxy address without credentials, a path, query, or fragment.
en.modelCatalogFailed: Available models could not be loaded.
en.modelCatalogIntro: Choose which Codex models appear in model selectors. Existing conversations can continue using a hidden model.
en.modelsAccountHelp: Proxy, model visibility, search and image options remain in Settings → Plugins → Codex Connect, or open them here:
en.modelsProviderSupport: Powered by the Codex Connect plugin.
en.nativeCompactionConsent: Enable and save to authorize automatic handling for Codex conversations in this profile, without triggering or confirming each compaction. This does not switch models, change reasoning effort, or enable other capabilities.
en.nativeCompactionDisableHelp: If native compaction is unavailable, DSH can use its normal summary path. Disabling stops new native compactions; in-flight requests may finish and existing native session checkpoints remain readable.
en.nativeCompactionHostPolicy: Uses DSH’s existing context-management timing and thresholds. If the host has explicitly disabled automatic compaction or has no compaction service, this switch does not override that host configuration.
en.nativeCompactionRisk: Compaction can lose details; it is not a complete copy of the conversation.
en.networkIntro: Codex Connect uses a direct connection by default. When needed, detect a local proxy or enter one manually.
en.noCuratedHighlights: No user-facing highlights were provided. See the full release notes for technical details.
en.pendingDirect: After saving, Codex Connect will stop using the proxy and connect directly.

en.updateHighlightAstraCompatibility: Added GPT-6-Astra compatibility metadata when the installed upstream catalog does not provide the model.
en.updateHighlightAutoReview: Added optional Codex Auto-review for eligible Harness approvals, with first-use disclosure, fail-closed human fallback, and an exact-retry override.
en.updateHighlightAutoReviewProbe: Added an explicit, synthetic probe for checking whether the hidden Codex approval reviewer is available without enabling it.
en.updateHighlightContextBudget: Added bounded per-model context budget controls while preserving each catalog default until you save an override.
en.updateHighlightDshRc7: Added compatibility with DSH rc.7 plugin slots and a clearer runtime compatibility check.
en.updateHighlightImageGeneration: Added optional GPT Image generation in the Codex Connect settings and a preview card in the conversation.
en.updateHighlightImageModelHint: Added an optional profile-scoped image route model hint. It is unverified, may be ignored or rejected, and does not guarantee the returned model.
en.updateHighlightLunaReserve: Added an optional Luna Reserve fallback for agent requests. It stays off by default and switches only when the backend explicitly authorizes Reserve for the current account.
en.updateHighlightModelsAccount: Added an Openai-Codex account card in Models settings for authorization, quota, and shared plugin settings.
en.updateHighlightModelVisibility: You can now choose which Codex models appear in model selectors.
en.updateHighlightMultiAccount: Added management for multiple ChatGPT accounts; starting or cancelling authorization preserves existing accounts.
en.updateHighlightOauthHistory: Added safer session-history migration and a sign-in fallback when the account needs to reconnect.
en.updateHighlightProxyConnection: Added opt-in Codex proxy detection with explicit confirmation and a visible direct-connection fallback.
en.updateHighlightQuotaFastMode: Added per-conversation Fast Mode and GPT quota/reset indicators in the Composer.
en.updateHighlightRuntimeCompatibility: Added a compatibility check and diagnostics so you can see whether the DSH and Node versions are supported.
en.updateHighlightSearchRoute: Enabling Codex Search now selects the profile-wide search route; disabling it restores the previous provider.
en.updateHighlightSearchStability: Improved search-session stability so new search records remain readable after restarts.
en.updateHighlightTrustedOrigins: Remote browser access can now be explicitly trusted for a LAN setup.
